--- PART 1/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE

RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "Parent slot3 fitness 267.8. Need produce new strategy." / "Parent fitness 267.8. Max possible vs always C is 500. Parent gets 300 vs always C."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates early, classifies opponents by defection rate, then defects against defectors, cooperates with cooperators, and uses occasional random forgiveness. The trace simulates the parent and proposed variants against population strategies such as always-C, TFT, and slot8. It changes the parent by adding an early defection test, exploitation of non-retaliating cooperators, and forgiveness after retaliation.

The trace simulates the parent against slots (always C, slot8, TFT, etc.) and revises it into a new strategy that limits early defections, forgives low-defection opponents, and exploits late-game unconditional cooperators.
